extraction.title: feat: 2fa backup codes
extraction.head: improve-two-factor-authentication-features

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding backup codes for 2FA across the Prisma schema, login flow, setup, and disable flow, with AES256 encryption. Reports "Confidence score: 3/5" and flags naming, validation, and state-management concerns in BackupCode.tsx, next-auth-options.ts, and login.tsx.
Style: the conditional rendering of TwoFactor and BackupCode is complex and should be extracted into a helper function for readability.
Logic: JSON.parse of the decrypted backupCodes can throw on corrupted data. Suggests wrapping it in try-catch and throwing InternalServerError.
Logic: the FIXME says the isChecked() assertion can pass when the two-factor switch is unchecked. Suggests asserting a data-state="checked" selector instead.
Style: the new backupCode parameter on disable() should be optional (backupCode?: string), since users supply either a TOTP code or a backup code.
Logic: sending an empty or undefined backupCode in the disable request body may cause problems. Suggests including only non-empty values in the payload.
Logic: the component function is named TwoFactor, which doesn't match its purpose or file name. Suggests renaming it to BackupCode.
Logic: minLength=10 and maxLength=11 are inconsistent for the 'XXXXX-XXXXX' format. Suggests exact length validation or a regex pattern.
Style: the error log message refers to 'backup code login', but this is the disable endpoint. Suggests changing the message to backup code verification.
Logic: formatBackupCode is called before it is defined (around line 163), which causes a reference error. Suggests defining it before use.
